activation_condition: Run only if the immutable ratio-0.10 capacity analyzer returns REJECT_CPROJ_RATIO10_TRANSFER.
scientific_question: If tenfold fixed-chart capacity does not improve c_proj, can the unchanged BlockFHT tangent express the useful c_proj update in the activation-weighted residual-stream metric even though it is unaligned in Euclidean weight space?

activation_manifold_result.fact: The V/O residual contribution is more curved and less PC1-concentrated than the value-output kernel, so the next metric must be data dependent.

endpoint_attribution_result.fact: Independent dense/generated endpoint swaps are strongly co-adapted and cannot select a trainable component.

projected_muon_result.fact: Polarizing after Euclidean tangent projection retains only 8.68 percent of the tangent oracle; projection and Muon do not commute.

fixed_right_result.fact: A nonlearned fixed-right family recovers only about 1.2 percent for c_proj; a learned dense basis is excluded as LoRA-like.

offline_diagnostic.runtime_policy: zero-update diagnostic expected under five minutes; foreground-poll directly and do not attach a watchdog
per_cell_measurement: capture c_proj input activations H and output gradients R on fixed validation batches
form the transient dense current-gradient target G = H^T R without retaining a dense optimizer state
form the dense current-gradient Muon polar target U
solve the exact Euclidean BlockFHT tangent projection for the registered ratio-0.01 and ratio-0.10 charts
solve the activation-weighted projection minimizing ||H (J delta - U)||_F with converged matrix-free CG
compare with equal-coordinate seeded Haar/tight-frame controls
primary_metrics: activation-output target energy recovery ||H J delta||_F^2 / ||H U||_F^2

preregistered_gate.minimum_layer_support: all five sampled layers have positive activation-output cosine
preregistered_gate.pass_action: Implement one activation-metric latent trust-region/preconditioned update on the unchanged fixed BlockFHT c_proj chart; require a fresh exact-config MFU gate before any training.
preregistered_gate.fail_action: Close fixed random c_proj chart expansion and Euclidean optimizer variants. Retain QK+V with dense c_proj as the honest compressed-attention fallback and study a jointly generated V/O functional map only through another preregistered offline gate.

exclusions: retained dense c_proj gradient or momentum
another static radial-gain, Cayley-rank, atlas, ProductFHT, or sparse-Givens training run
training before the offline gate passes
